name: kxtrumppardon
title: Who will Trump pardon in 2026?
settlement: Each market resolves YES if President Trump grants that named individual a presidential pardon, commutation, or reprieve during his second term and before Jan 1, 2027. Otherwise it resolves NO. Each of the 34 named individuals is a separate outcome of this one event.
decideContext: You are estimating the probability (0-100%) that a specific named individual receives a Trump pardon, commutation, or reprieve before Jan 1, 2027; the market resolves YES only upon an official White House pardon/clemency action covering that person, so news must indicate actual or imminent executive clemency action, not just advocacy or rumor.
